desc: Derive the exact completion-count formula for remaining odd/even counts with a required next parity, including feasibility when parity counts are unequal.
Implement lexicographic unranking by scanning unused values and skipping completion blocks.
Track unused values and parity counts efficiently for n <= 100.
Cap counts safely at k (up to 10^15) and handle n=1, invalid k, and parity imbalances.
Run the provided examples and additional edge-case tests against the implementation.
